sloka: अभ्यनुज्ञातुम् इच्छामः सह एभिः मुनिपुङ्गवैः ।धर्म नित्यैः तपो दान्तैः विशिखैः इव पावकैः ॥३-८-७॥
transliteration: abhyanujñātum icchāmaḥ saha ebhiḥ munipuṅgavaiḥ ।dharma nityaiḥ tapo dāntaiḥ viśikhaiḥ iva pāvakaiḥ ॥3-8-7॥

translations.english: We seek your permission to go with the great sages, who are ever engaged in righteousness, selfcontrolled by virtue of their penance, and are like flameless fire.
